title: Shinkansen, then Nara
call: Good for Nara until mid-afternoon. tenki.jp's 05:00 Nara hourly has clear sun until 15:00, 0 to 10%, peaking at 30° at 13:00, so the deer, Kasuga Taisha and Tōdai-ji should be dry and hot. Light rain from about 16:00, about 1 mm at 17:00, then light rain into the evening. That's the walk to the 16:45 Kintetsu, so umbrellas out from 16:00. JMA still flags thunder possible from late morning: if you hear it, head inside Tōdai-ji or a café. Lots of water.
plan: Open ground, the most exposed part of the day
